challenge_scope: GLOBAL; all mints unknown:challenged during cooldown; one probe after; third consecutive challenged cooldown disables until operator re-enables
clock: source host receipt minus its stored finite clock_offset_s; compare with sheet_as_of; no implicit zero offset
identity: exact candidate network solana + mint + pool; another pair is not_served
label: provider_claim
not_served: successful page read with no own-pair stats; no capture is unknown:no_capture
partial_parse: vol_24h/buys_24h/sells_24h mandatory; malformed/missing is unknown:not_served_unparsed; pair_age_s may be null with field_unknown.pair_age_s=not_reported
population: desk candidates that passed cheap gates; never all intake
rounding: public display quantities/pair-age are provider-rounded claims, not exact measurements
transport: anonymous public rendered DexScreener page only; separate worker, local cache, no JUDGE fetch
